translations.translatedText: # Tuesday 17.1.2023 (radio)
Strike warning for the technology industry. Telia plans redundancies. The euro area may avoid a recession. EU emergency stockpile for Finland. The polar night ends. Weather forecast.
## Strike warning for the technology industry
![Chair of the Industrial Union Riku Aalto.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5113,h_2876,x_6,y_248/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-105690563bbda2d90353/1673261385)
Open image viewer
Chair of the Industrial Union Riku Aalto says that in pay negotiations the employer has not agreed to take into account the rise in prices and living costs. Photo: Heikki Saukkomaa / Lehtikuva
The industrial employee organisations have issued strike warnings for the technology industry and the chemical industry. The strikes will start in early February, and they will last three days.

The Industrial Union has issued a strike warning that concerns 50 workplaces and over 7,000 employees. YTN, the union for senior white-collar workers, has issued a strike warning that concerns 10 firms and about 5,000 people. The trade union Pro has also submitted a strike warning.
The collective bargaining talks in the technology industry have been difficult. Employers and employees have not been able to agree on pay rises.
## Telia plans redundancies
![Telia Teollisuuskatu, formerly TeliaSonera.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5405,h_3040,x_289,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/17-7856858da2d15c49f8/1578408477)
Open image viewer
Telia is starting change negotiations. Photo: Derrick Frilund / Yle
Telecoms operator Telia plans redundancies.
Telia is starting change negotiations, which concern about 800 people. The negotiations may lead to more than a hundred people being made redundant.
Telia employs about four thousand people in Finland.
Similar negotiations have also been started in Sweden and Norway.
## The euro area may avoid a recession
![Euro sculpture in front of the old ECB headquarters.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10966913)
Open image viewer
The euro area economy may grow a little this year, estimates a US bank. Photo: Jonathan Larsen / AOP
The euro area may not after all have an economic recession, even though this was predicted earlier.

The US bank Goldman Sachs earlier estimated that the euro area's economy would shrink by 0.1 percent this year. Now the bank has changed its forecast and estimates that the euro area's economy will grow by 0.6 percent this year.
The change in the forecast is due to China lifting its corona lockdowns, and to the price of energy having fallen.
## EU emergency stockpile for Finland
![Krista Mikkonen speaks.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5000,h_2812,x_0,y_97/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-96712762a0ae5a7ef9f/1665676180)
Open image viewer
Interior Minister Krista Mikkonen told of the EU emergency stockpile coming to Finland. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle
An EU rescue and medical supplies stockpile will be set up in Finland. The stockpile is being set up for crisis situations and major accidents.
The stockpile will contain, for example, personal protective equipment, measuring devices and medicines.
The project costs about 240 million euros, and it is financed by the European Commission.
## The polar night ends in the north

![Snowy fell landscape in the middle of the polar night. Orange-yellow light shows on the horizon.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1021,h_575,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-105140663a2bf71bafc7/1671610294)
Open image viewer
The polar night in Utsjoki lasted almost 2 months. Photo: Tomi Vartiainen
The polar night ended today in Utsjoki, Finland's northernmost municipality.
The sun rose in the sky at midday for about an hour.
The polar night is the dark time of winter. At that time the sun does not rise in the sky at all.
The polar night lasted almost 2 months in Utsjoki.
## Wednesday's weather
![Weather map of Finland.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12688010)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
On Wednesday snow showers move from south to north. In the daytime the weather clears in the south.
In the south and central parts of the country the temperature is between -1 and +1 degrees.
In the north there is a little frost.
